name: FOMO — Solana memecoin copy-trader
MONEY_WARNING: THIS IS THE ONE BOT IN THE FLEET THAT SPENDS REAL MONEY. It signs real Solana mainnet
swaps through Jupiter with a real wallet key. Everything else in this drop is paper.
OPEN SECURITY ITEM: the wallet's private key was pasted into a chat transcript twice on
2026-08-02 and has NOT been rotated. The wallet is also a privy embedded wallet, so
fomo.family can spend it independently of the bot whenever Robbie is logged in.
what_it_is: It watches ~58 traders on fomo.family and mirrors their buys at 0.5% of their size,
$1-$10 a trade, capped at 8 concurrent coins. Two distinct traders on the same coin
inside 45 minutes unlocks full size; a lone trader gets half. Exits are +60% (sell 40%),
+200% (sell half the rest), -45% hard stop, 28% trail from the high after TP1, and a
12-hour time stop if the position is under +15%.
why_there_is_no_genome: Its entry signal is another human's transaction. Not a window, not an indicator — a
person. There is no price rule to put in a genome, and the seven genes describe price
history the bot never looks at before buying.
why_it_cannot_run_in_the_village: No village data source prices Solana memecoins. ccxt, yahoo and alpaca all cover listed
assets; these tokens are hours old and trade on Jupiter. There is also no feed of who
bought what on fomo.family. Both halves of the strategy are missing, not just one.

verdict_already_measured.headline: A null. Over 262 closed trades the bot is somewhere between -0.006 and +0.078 SOL.
verdict_already_measured.method: On-chain scan 2026-08-02, splitting transactions by fee payer — the only reliable way to separate the bot from Robbie's own manual trading on the same shared wallet.
verdict_already_measured.bot_transactions: 400 txs, -0.0063 SOL net, of which 0.0398 SOL was fees
verdict_already_measured.win_rate_trap: Post-refuel win rate ~49.7% clears the 45% bar it was judged against while the money does nothing. Win rate without expectancy, again.
verdict_already_measured.its_own_ledger_is_wrong: close_position() computes pnl = cost_usd * gain — no fees, no slippage, quoted price rather than fill. Its 'realized -$2.28' structurally cannot show what trading cost.
verdict_already_measured.partial_scans_flatter: Three intermediate estimates (+1.15, +0.078, +0.19 SOL) all revised downward as RPC coverage completed. The transactions that failed to fetch were disproportionately losses.
verdict_already_measured.fixed_bug_worth_knowing: The hard stop refused to sell whenever price impact exceeded 20% — exactly when a thin coin is crashing. Six positions rode to as low as -99.3% before f7cd7ef added an emergency path on 2026-08-04.
